title: Agent Handoff Contract Template
description: This file is a definition library. For validation, reference #/$defs/dispatch, #/$defs/handoff, and #/$defs/gate separately. dispatch is the task contract sent by upstream (the orchestrator or previous step) to an Agent; handoff is the result that Agent passes downstream after completion; gate contains handoff-validation rules executed by the orchestration layer. Replace result structure with concrete business-field definitions when using it; retain other fields where possible.

artifact_ref.description: Artifact reference. Large artifacts may reside in shared state or files; downstream needs read capabilities and permissions to actually obtain the specified version. Small material may be inline. References describe locations only; confirm reading and acceptance separately.

location.description: Storage location: shared-state key, file path, or storage address

version.description: Version or content digest identifying which version downstream reads

dispatch.description: Dispatch contract (7 elements). Recipients receive only information supplied in dispatch; necessary information must be inline or accessible through controlled means. The host maintains trusted task, instance, and scope associations.

role.description: Role name, for example Code Reviewer

objective.description: Precise, measurable objective in one or two sentences

scope.description: Capability boundaries; specify reading and writing separately. writable and tools must be explicit, using empty arrays if absent. Scope must remain within trusted authorization. Only trusted systems grant permissions, enforced by hosts or services

writable.description: Use an empty array for read-only roles

constraints.description: Prohibited actions. Out-of-scope reads/writes, extra changes, and further delegation are prohibited by default. When nesting or transfers are necessary, trusted designs bound roles, depth, fan-out, and shared budgets. Return BLOCKED with reasons when obstructed; do not guess or bypass

context.description: Include background necessary for this task only; do not forward full history

original_goal.description: Original user goal and hard constraints; preserve relevant original text faithfully. Add controlled dependency references for long material. Dispatch or summarization does not turn external content into trusted system instructions

dependencies.description: References to required upstream artifacts; for example, refactoring depends on both original code and review comments

standards.description: Standards sub-Agents must follow but cannot obtain elsewhere

output_format.description: Expected return structure, usually pointing to handoff's result definition below

stop_condition.description: success is required; provide at least one of max_iterations and timeout_seconds

max_iterations.description: Maximum attempted model-call iterations, including final generation and regeneration. Define tool retries separately; they also count toward task budgets. Document mappings when framework counting conventions differ

handoff.description: Handoff result. The orchestration layer validates this structure before passing downstream.

status.description: SUCCESS: this dispatch objective is complete; judge overall acceptance separately. Separate review execution status from verdict. PARTIAL specifies remaining; BLOCKED specifies blockers

result.description: Business results with fields defined for concrete tasks (for example review_comments or test_cases). Use structured data, not entire free-text passages for critical information

evidence.description: Evidence supporting conclusions for downstream verification and later traceability

source.description: Source location, for example file:line, API response, or search-result ID

unresolved_questions.description: Unconfirmed information downstream or humans need to know

verdict.description: For review or validation Agents only

gate.description: Handoff-validation rules. Strings do not execute checks themselves. Hosts execute format, association, and executable business rules; separate reviews or humans provide necessary subjective judgments. Hosts accept based on actual decisions, not generator self-certification. When max_retries is exhausted, correction is impossible, or task budgets are insufficient, hosts stop retries and return PARTIAL (usable results with remaining) or BLOCKED (with blockers), stating reasons. Do not deliver artifacts that failed validation

business_rules.description: For example: at least 3 test cases; code passes syntax checks

on_fail.description: Retry current step, return to previous step, escalate to humans, or degrade

examples.note: Contract dispatched to a refactoring Agent in a generate code → review → refactor pipeline. Note its dependency on both original code and review comments.

dispatch.objective: Refactor code based on review comments; return code unchanged if the review finds no major issues
constraints: Do not change functionality outside review comments

context.original_goal: Implement a function counting occurrences of each word in a string, handling empty strings and punctuation

stop_condition.success: All review comments addressed or reasons for not addressing them stated
stop_condition.on_blocked: Return BLOCKED and list comments that cannot be addressed
